name: "Contribute to Anatome"
about: "Suggest an improvement, new foundation model, or feature for drug discovery"
title: "[CONTRIBUTE]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "scientific-breakthrough"]
assignees: ""

---

### Contribution Track
- [ ] Structural Biology & Biophysics (e.g. docking, folding, scoring)
- [ ] Foundation Models & Model Studio (e.g. LoRA recipes, fine-tuning)
- [ ] Wet-Lab Automation (e.g. Tecan, Opentrons, robotics)
- [ ] Full-Stack & Developer Experience (UI, WebGL, performance)
- [ ] Other

### What breakthrough or capability does this enable?
A clear description of the scientific challenge, model, or feature you want to add.

### Proposed Implementation Details
How do you envision this being integrated? (e.g. BioNeMo API, local Python wrapper, WebGL shader, new UI tab)

### Relevant Papers, Datasets, or Benchmarks
Link any relevant academic literature, PDB structures, or ChEMBL assays if applicable.
